exercises.prompt: Complete the conditional sentence whose result clause is nominal ('If you are patient, then God is with you'):
exercises.explanation: When the apodosis (jazāʾ) of a conditional sentence is a nominal clause, fāʾ al-jazāʾ (فَـ) is mandatory.

feedback.rule: Fāʾ al-jazāʾ is mandatory before nominal, imperative, negated, or particle-introduced apodoses.

exercises.prompt: Which mood does إِنْ ('if') govern on both the protasis and apodosis verbs in إِنْ تَجْتَهِدْ تَنْجَحْ?
exercises.explanation: إِنْ is a jussive conditional particle governing both the condition verb (تَجْتَهِدْ) and the result verb (تَنْجَحْ) in jazm.

feedback.rule: إِنْ governs two jussive verbs (fiʿl al-sharṭ and jawāb al-sharṭ).
